question: When do equal final chances fail to make a lottery fair because of post-draw acceptance authority?
claim: For a lottery used to replace discretionary ranking between equal claims, equal chances alone do not establish procedural fairness when an interested party has unreviewable authority to make exceptions after observing a draw. A binding acceptance rule or justified, answerable delegation is needed. The stronger claim about authority under guaranteed outcome-neutral constraints is unresolved.

included: lottery used instead of comparative discretionary ranking
interested actor with possible post-draw exception authority
excluded_or_unsettled: mere physical execution of a binding rule
pure status objection when every allowed act preserves all relevant chances

distinctions.definition: Equal probability of each claimant receiving the good under the implemented mechanism, conditional on relevant information.
Power after observing a draw or history to decide whether its result binds or is replaced.
A prospective rule, review procedure, or valid delegation that makes acceptance authority answerable.
Publishing a rule informs participants; it does not bind an official who can depart without review.

premises.text: A lottery between equal claims can be justified as avoiding discretionary ranking where no relevant basis for ranking is available.
Equal final probabilities establish a distributive feature but do not specify who controls finality after a draw.
Unreviewable post-draw exception power gives its holder a second-order right to decide which realization governs.
When a lottery is offered to replace discretionary ranking, an interested holder’s unreviewable exception power reintroduces discretion at the point of finality.
Such reintroduced discretion is procedurally unfair absent valid delegation or an answerable public constraint.
premises.status: central normative premise; unresolved under guaranteed outcome-neutral authority

premises.text: Equal chances under an announced rule are insufficient where an interested party can make unreviewable post-draw exceptions.

worked_case.mechanism: X,Y are independent fair bits. If X differs from Y, use X. If X equals Y, rerun with independent fair bit Z.

calculation.details: XX=00 and XX=11 each contribute 1/8 to A after rerun; X=1,Y=0 contributes 1/4; X=0,Y=1 contributes 0.

worked_case.deviation: If the official accepts A on X=Y=1 instead of rerunning, P(A) rises by 1/8 to 5/8.
worked_case.what_it_shows: A binding symmetric rerun can be outcome-neutral; an unreviewable exception can alter the distribution.
worked_case.what_it_does_not_show: It does not establish a pure procedural complaint when every permitted exercise is guaranteed to preserve all relevant chances.

assessor_engagement.challenge: Does objectionable control remain with full disclosure and guaranteed preservation of every relevant chance?
assessor_engagement.response: The proposal distinguishes disclosure from a binding constraint and answers only cases where unchecked exceptions can alter outcomes; the stronger equal-chance case is explicitly unresolved.

assessor_engagement.attribution: No separately attributed contribution declared in the supplied file.
assessor_engagement.challenge: The status objection may disappear under full disclosure, waiver, and preserved probabilities, or reduce to deception/control already captured elsewhere.
assessor_engagement.response: Accepts the force of valid informed delegation and narrows the claim; disclosure alone is not treated as equivalent to enforceable constraint. The unresolved status-only case remains open.

failure_conditions: A fully specified equal-conditional-probability model with meaningful unreviewable post-draw authority yields no defensible fairness complaint.
Primary-source analysis supports an outcome-only account in the closest domain.
Valid informed and optional delegation defeats the concern across the intended scope.
The constraint/administration distinction cannot be defended without begging the question.
Closest literature already contains the same contribution without a defensible refinement.
